title: PPL (Under 30 Mins)
author: Bhavin S.
desc: Unleash your strength with the PPL(30 Min) program, a dynamic 18-week training regimen designed for those who want to maximize results in minimal time. With six days of expertly crafted push, pull, and leg workouts each week, you'll build muscle and enhance endurance in just half an hour per session. This program is perfect for busy lifters looking to stay committed and see significant progress without sacrificing their schedule. Get ready to transform your physique and elevate your fitness game!
